_comment: Tier-2 for dealii stokes#1. Tier-2 for dealii stokes#1 -- probe "block_renumbering" of the shared translation unit _shared/stokes_family.cc, compiled once and cached so every fixture that names a probe of that unit shares ONE C++ build. Taylor-Hood Q2/Q1 on a 2-refinement hyper_cube. The probe prints the block SIZES before and after DoFRenumbering::component_wise -- they are identical, so the sizes are NOT the diagnostic -- and then assembles the BlockSparseMatrix and reports the (1,1) block's Frobenius norm, which is the diagnostic. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 makes the probe run the CORRECT variant, and the fixture then fails its own expectations. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build; Debug at the dbgbuild tree where the fixture sets requires_debug); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run.
